text: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China is Standard Bank Group's largest shareholder, with 325.0 million shares, 19.7%, as at 30 June 2026. South Africa's Government Employees Pension Fund (PIC) is the second-largest holder, with 14.3%.
short: ICBC is Standard Bank Group's largest shareholder, with 19.7% as at 30 June 2026.

source.name: Standard Bank Group: Shareholder information
source.quote: Industrial and commercial Bank of China 325.0 19.7
source.note: Top-10 shareholders table, 1H26 column: 'Beneficial holdings determined from the share register and investigations conducted on our behalf in terms of section 56 of the Companies Act as at 30 June 2026'; second line: 'Government Employees Pension Fund (PIC) 235.7 14.3'.

additionalSources.name: FinHive Africa: Who Owns Africa's Biggest Banks?
additionalSources.quote: ICBC’s 19.6% stake in Standard Bank remains the single largest strategic investment in African banking
additionalSources.note: FinHive gives the stake as 19.6% (325 million shares, 'held for 19 years') against Standard Bank Group's own 19.7%, and says the 2007 deal came with two board seats. ICBC bought 20% of Standard Bank in 2007-2008; the holding was later diluted to just under 20%.
